annotations.title: Planet retrograde dates for a year

description: Lists every retrograde period of Mercury, Venus, Mars, Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, Neptune or Pluto that falls in or overlaps a year from 2025 to 2030 (a year with none says so and names the next one), with sign, shadows, cazimi or opposition, and stations. Times are UTC, to the minute, from the ephemeris (JPL DE421, 2025–2030). This is astronomical timing, not a horoscope. Paid tool: $0.005 per call in USDC on Base via x402 (HTTP 402 with payment requirements; retry with a PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header). Free tools cover the current status and the next retrograde.
name: planet_retrograde_dates
title: Planet retrograde dates for a year
